setting: predictor setting by cross-validation (adopted in round 2: width 768, dropout 0.5)
description: TS-to-Chart predictor (flow-matching MLP on numbers, one model per dataset), K=32 candidates; the selector is initialized from the FNSPID selector (seed 0) and fine-tuned on this dataset alone. Steps marked 'common' are shared by all Time-MMD datasets. Five seeds are trained (seed 0 has no tag suffix, seed s the suffix _s<s>); the reported number is the mean over the three seeds with the lowest validation target (val_best in results/<tag>.json).

cross_validation: Predictor setting by cross-validation (visor/pools.py cv): every candidate setting is rebuilt with --oof 5 as tmK_<setting> and scored by the medoid MAE over the out-of-fold train rows plus the validation rows; a setting replaces the current one only under a paired one-sided t-test with a Bonferroni correction. Round 1 settings: tmmdQ_w128ex0, tmmdQ_w256ex0, tmmdR_w256ex0, tmmdR_w512ex0, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.3, tmmdR_w512ex0lr1e-4, tmmdR_w512ex0p60k, tmmdR_w128ex0, tmmdR_w256ex0dr0.3, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5, tmmdR_w512ex0s5k, tmmdR_w512ex0s10k, tmmdR_w512ex0d2, tmmdR_w512ex0nfe64, tmmdR_w512ex0preM2002, tmmdR_w512ex0preW2015, tmmdR_w512ex0robust, tmmdR_w512ex0sqrt, tmmdR_w512ex0zscore; round 2 adds: tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.6, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.7, tmmdR_w1024ex0dr0.5, tmmdR_w768ex0dr0.5, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5lr1e-4, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5lr3e-4, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5s10k, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5d2, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5d4, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5nfe64, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5sqrt, tmmdR_w512ex0dr0.5bs128. Setting names: Q = no pretraining, R = --pre auto, w = --width, ex0 = --extra 0, dr = --drop, lr = --lr, s5k/s10k = --steps, d = --depth, nfe = --nfe, p60k = --pre_steps 60000, pre<corpus> = --pre <dataset>=<corpus> for all datasets, robust/sqrt/zscore = --rep.
